title: Form-to-Sheet Automation
summary: Google Form responses will land in a formatted sheet without breaking formulas, plus an automatic weekly summary report.
result: Designed so every response lands in the right row with formulas intact, and a PDF summary goes out every Monday.

metric.label: of copy-paste per week, estimated for 20 responses a day at about 2 minutes each, 5 days a week (20 × 2 min × 5 ≈ 3.3 h)

upworkBlurb: Demo project, build in progress. Google Forms to Google Sheets automation with Apps Script: each response will be cleaned and written into a formatted sheet without breaking formulas, dropdowns or formatting, with a lock against simultaneous submissions. A weekly summary will be exported as a PDF and emailed every Monday, with a Settings tab for recipients. Designed to save about 3 hours a week (estimate based on 20 responses a day at about 2 minutes each). Fictitious data. Stack: Google Forms, Sheets, Apps Script, Gmail.
